title: Three Months and One Short Scale
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：pound　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pound 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the shopkeeper ① paid the pound that no buyer in the shop would have recorded, and he said the paying was the whole of the month. The ② pound, meaning the unit itself and not the scale, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a pound, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ pound in that shop had the same short scale beside it, and the ④ pound at the far counter, meaning the coin they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pound, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the shopkeeper said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pound was the whole of the matter, meaning the value and not the unit. The ⑥ pound, meaning the value and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; pound, he said, is either something you pay or the only word that means both a unit and a value. He said the value is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ pound had become a line in an account, and the account had become an argument about the short scale. The ⑧ pound of the whole thing, the shopkeeper wrote in July, was one shop and three months of recording; pound, he said, is either the coin at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pound I remember is the unit recorded in the account, which closed in 1979 and is still recorded as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ pound, my mother said in 1981, is the only unit that improves by being recorded; every pound, she said, is a value that has agreed to look like a unit. She said the value was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 英镑；磅（指铺子里每一镑旁边的那一镑）
B. n. 英镑；磅（指那镑英镑本身，与小小的秤相对）
C. 固定搭配：pay the pound 付这一镑英镑
D. n. 英镑；磅（指留给孩子们数的那一枚）
E. n. 英镑之事（抽象总称，指一处铺子的英镑之事）
F. n. 英镑；磅（指账本里写到、被记载的那一镑）
G. n. 英镑、价值（指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 价值（抽象总称，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: paid the pound that no buyer in the shop would have recorded
The pound, meaning the unit itself and not the scale
the pound at the far counter
the pound was the whole of the matter
the pound had become a line in an account
The pound of the whole thing
A pound, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: pay the pound 意为“付这一镑英镑”，1972 年那位掌柜把铺子里没有一位买主肯记载的一镑英镑做了一遍。
pound 意为“英镑；磅”，指那镑英镑本身而不是小小的秤，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
pound 意为“英镑；磅”，指铺子里每一镑旁边的那一镑，每一镑旁边都有同一杆小小的秤。
pound 意为“英镑；磅”，指最远那张柜台的留给孩子们数的那一枚，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pound 意为“英镑、价值”，指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这镑价值就是那件事的全部。
pound 意为“价值”，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西而不是那镑英镑，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pound 意为“英镑；磅”，指账本里写到、被记载的那一镑，到 1977 年这一镑成了账本里的一行。
pound 意为“英镑之事”，掌柜七月写道，整件事的英镑之事是一处铺子和三个月份的记载。
pound 意为“英镑；磅”，我记得的是账本里记载过的那一镑，1979 年结清了，至今仍被说成铺子里最安静的一镑。
pound 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，英镑是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的英镑。
